answers.why: All Israel joins Rehoboam in forsaking the LORD's law.
Judah is the kingdom whose fortified cities Shishak captures.
Judah's princes gather with Rehoboam in Jerusalem because of Shishak.
Israel's princes humble themselves alongside King Rehoboam.
Good things are found in Judah during Rehoboam's reign.
Abijah begins reigning over the kingdom of Judah.
Abijah addresses Jeroboam and all Israel assembled against him.
The LORD is identified as the God of the nation receiving David's kingship.
Israel is the nation over which God gave David and his sons kingship.
Judah is the army facing Jeroboam's forces and their ambush.
Judah's soldiers turn, see battle on both sides, and cry to the LORD.
The men of Judah give a battle shout.
The men of Judah are shouting as God strikes their opponents.
All Israel is Jeroboam's fighting force defeated by God.
Judah is the victorious army alongside Abijah.
The Israelites flee before Judah and are delivered into their hands.
Five hundred thousand chosen men fall slain from Israel's army.
